name: Open Library
label: Open Library
description: Open Library official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: search, work_get, edition_get, author_get, isbn_get. Docs: https://openlibrary.org/developers/api. Internet Archive / Open Library terms. Courtesy throttle. Identifying User-Agent. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Open Library request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"search"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: search | work_get | edition_get | author_get | isbn_get. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'search'.

schema.label: author_id
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `author_id` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: edition_id
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `edition_id` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: isbn
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `isbn` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `limit` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `page` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `q` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: work_id
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `work_id` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: search | work_get | isbn_get | author_get | edition_get. Example: 'search'.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
